title: Add ownerId to SceneAsset; make mediaType immutable
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Add ownerId to SceneAsset; make mediaType immutable
Spec (61f2d14): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L268: "`ownerId` (String, immutable, server-set): The userId of the user who created this asset." L277: "`mediaType` (String, immutable)". L689: "The server sets `id`, `accountId`, `ownerId`, `size`, and `createdAt`." L691: "`update` supports patching `name`, `assetUri`, and `sha256`. All other properties are immutable or server-set."
Code: crate-jmap-scene-types/src/asset.rs:14-40; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/asset.rs:41; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/asset.rs:45; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/asset.rs:395-416
Now: SceneAsset has no owner_id. SERVER_SET is [id, accountId, size, createdAt] and IMMUTABLE is [id, accountId, blobId, size, createdAt]. update_asset accepts a mediaType patch and validates it against supportedVisualTypes.
Change: Add `owner_id: String` to SceneAsset. Add ownerId to SERVER_SET and IMMUTABLE, set it on create and echo it in `created`. Make update accept only name/assetUri/sha256 (add mediaType and ownerId to IMMUTABLE). may_modify_asset should key on ownerId.
